note: Structured mirror of the DWS north-star metric pair — Monthly Governed Decisions (MGD) + Customer-Retained Capital (CRC). Founder-ratified by Risto Anton Päärni (Founder, CEO · Lifetime Oy) 2026-07-13 per the field-note §3 definitions. Registered in DWS_TRUTH_STANDARD.md §2 row 32. Lets scripts/lint-truth-claims.mjs and /truth-check flag the deprecated acquisition/activity 'anti-game' phrasings (field-note §2 table) in new public-layer copy, and steer copy toward the outcome-metric language. Metric definitions below are copied verbatim from the field note §3 — this file is a machine-readable reflection, not a reinterpretation.
canonicalSources: DWS_TRUTH_STANDARD.md §2A Pillar 2 (Orchestration Over Components — agent/skill count is never a headline)

ratification.ratifiedBy: Risto Anton Päärni, Founder, CEO · Lifetime Oy

primary.definitionVerbatim: Monthly Governed Decisions (MGD) — primary. A decision counts only when it (a) flows through the governed outcome layer, (b) carries full Article 12 reasoning lineage, and (c) is audit-grade (would survive regulator or internal-audit scrutiny). Pilots, demos, and ungoverned agent runs do not count — exactly as MySpace's dormant accounts did not count for Facebook.

criteria.name: governed-outcome-layer
criteria.text: flows through the governed outcome layer

criteria.name: audit-grade
criteria.text: is audit-grade (would survive regulator or internal-audit scrutiny)

secondary.definitionVerbatim: Customer-Retained Capital (CRC) — secondary/compounding. The 4P assets (ontology, skills, calibrated Control Room thresholds, evaluated datasets) the customer owns after the engagement. This is the anti-Karp metric: proof DWS's game is capital formation, not extraction.

As a DWS success/headline claim it is a deprecated anti-game (field-note §2); lead with 'Monthly Governed Decisions' / 'decisions that survive audit'.
ambiguousDisplayPhrasesNeedingContext.invalidIf: Used as a DWS success or headline metric in positioning / investor / sales copy.
